product_brief: Hardware-optimized PQC algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, LMS) embedded in Secure Elements and Crypto co-processors.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and LMS algorithms. Optimized for faster throughput in hardware implementations. Embedded in Secure-IC's integrated Secure Elements (Securyzr™ iSEs S100, S300, S700, S900 neo series) and Securyzr™ Crypto Solutions/Crypto co-processors. Strictly follows NIST PQC requirements.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, LMS, SHA3-224, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256
testing_&_validation_methods: ACVP/CAVP conformance (Validated via Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program)
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Embedded in Secure Elements (Securyzr™ iSEs) and Crypto co-processors; optimized for hardware implementations.
